definitions.explanation: The process of rebuilding and restoring an area after disaster or destruction.
The process of bringing back prosperity, activity, or cultural traditions that had declined.

examples.japanese: {震災|しんさい}からの{復興|ふっこう}が{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: Recovery from the earthquake disaster is progressing.

examples.japanese: {地域経済|ちいきけいざい}の{復興|ふっこう}に{取|と}り{組|く}む。
examples.english: We are working on the revival of the local economy.

examples.japanese: {戦後|せんご}{復興|ふっこう}は{日本|にほん}の{奇跡|きせき}と{呼|よ}ばれた。
examples.english: The post-war reconstruction was called Japan's miracle.

notes:
WORD STRUCTURE:
{復|ふく} (return, restore) + {興|こう} (prosper, flourish)
Literally: "restoring prosperity"

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{復興|ふっこう}{支援|しえん} - reconstruction support
・{復興|ふっこう}{事業|じぎょう} - reconstruction project
・{復興|ふっこう}{計画|けいかく} - recovery plan
・{復興|ふっこう}を{目指|めざ}す - to aim for reconstruction
・{復興|ふっこう}に{向|む}けて - toward recovery

HISTORICAL CONTEXTS:
・{戦後|せんご}{復興|ふっこう} - post-war reconstruction
・{震災|しんさい}{復興|ふっこう} - earthquake disaster recovery
・{東日本|ひがしにほん}{大震災|だいしんさい}{復興|ふっこう} - Great East Japan Earthquake reconstruction

GOVERNMENT TERMINOLOGY:
・{復興庁|ふっこうちょう} - Reconstruction Agency (established after 2011 earthquake)
・{復興|ふっこう}{特別|とくべつ}{税|ぜい} - special reconstruction tax
